changelog:
Initial release of the daily-report skill.

- Added support for generating daily work reports by discovering all relevant git repositories and summarizing activity.
- Collects commit logs across all branches and includes CodeBuddy Agent session overviews.
- Supports flexible date selection: today, yesterday, specific date, or days ago.
- Output includes structured stats, per-repo details, and high-level summaries.
- Reports are automatically generated in the user’s preferred language.
- Requires only Python 3.6+ and git CLI, with zero additional configuration by default.
